title: NCAAB tab bet record is in (app v1.0.147). It tracks only the bets you place by hand from the NCAAB tab: number of bets, money bet, profit/loss, record (won-lost-pushed), percent won, return on money, still-open bets, average bet and best/worst, all time and today, plus a By day list and a By kind of bet list (spread, total, moneyline). It is one line at the top of the NCAAB tab (tap Details) and a full card at the top of the Tracker's Stats page; the Tracker also has a new NCAAB filter chip that makes its lists and every stat that tab's bets alone. Days are the Tracker's game days (5 am to 5 am Eastern). Auto bets, bids and voids are not counted. Bets you already placed from the tab are recognised; a game-sheet check mark placed before this version cannot be told apart. Note: the NCAAB tab bets now leave the Tracker's Vigilant chip and the By-scanner split, since they are their own source.
